zh: 账号按部门管理：总经办、采购部、销售部、仓储部、财务部；每个部门可新增职位（如采购员、收银员），新增账号先选部门再选职位，账号代码自动生成
付款审批：会计提交申请 → 总经理批准或驳回 → 出纳凭流水号付款，每一步都有记录
只用本国货币结算，去掉美元选项（总经理可在设置里选择结算货币）
客户和供应商可以删除（有未结清货款或未完成单据时会提示先处理）
数据自动保存到云端，图片与华宝招聘同一存储方式（压缩 + 缩略图），手机更省空间更流畅
初始 1 个门店，新增门店需要开通码；账号列表“重新编辑”可修改职位
en: Accounts by department: GM's office, Purchasing, Sales, Warehouse, Finance; each department can add positions; new accounts pick department then position and get a code automatically
Payment approval: the accountant requests → the GM approves or rejects → the cashier pays with a reference; every step is recorded
Settles in the local currency only; the US$ option is gone (the GM picks the settlement currency in settings)
Customers and suppliers can be deleted (unless they still have unpaid balances or open orders)
Data saves to the cloud automatically; photos stored the same way as ChinaPaw (compressed + thumbnails) for a lighter, smoother phone
Starts with 1 store; each new store needs an activation code; “Edit” in the account list can change the position
